purpose: Check whether one controlled HEADER variable change is accompanied by a structural change in the post-sentinel bytes of ODA-produced AC1027 DWGs.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local sample; original producer is unauthenticated. No source or derived drawing was added to the repository.

controlConstruction.conversion: Cover.dwg to ACAD2013 ASCII DXF in scratch storage
controlConstruction.pair: Two copies of the ODA-produced DXF differ in exactly one HEADER value: $LTSCALE group 40, 1.0 versus 2.0.
controlConstruction.limitation: ODA rejected two separate locally authored minimal AC1027 DWGs with '.dwg file needs recovery'; those were not used as controls. The qualified pair was built from an existing sample's ODA-produced DXF with only the stated scalar changed.

libdxfrw.strictOutput: Refused at the existing AC1027 source-reference gate; no DXF published.
Refused at the existing AC1027 source-reference gate; no DXF published.

validation.headerEnvelope: Both extracted logical HEADER sections contain the expected start/end sentinels and pass the existing CRC16 check.
validation.independentDecoder: LibreDWG 0.14 JSON reports HEADER.LTSCALE 1.0 and 2.0 respectively.
validation.suffixComparison: The suffix SHA-256 values differ and lengths differ by 8 bytes. No byte role, suffix boundary, padding rule, or causal mapping to $LTSCALE is established.
validation.interpretation: The controlled pair confirms the scalar change survives ODA AC1027 output. The different HEADER sizes and suffix lengths are an observation only; keep all post-sentinel bytes unclaimed and strict output refused.

fixturePolicy: All generated DXF, DWG, raw-page, JSON and log files remain under /private/tmp; none was committed.
